ambiguities.text: The index page lists modules but does not specify the exact fork activation criteria or block number.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Osaka follows standard fork activation patterns with a designated block number or timestamp. This needs verification from fork.py module.

ambiguities.text: The requests.py module is mentioned but the specific protocol requests supported are not detailed in the index.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume requests follow EIP-7685 pattern for system-level operations. Requires examination of requests.py for specifics.

implicit_assumptions.description: Osaka fork assumes all previous fork rules (through Prague) are correctly implemented and activated.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing or incorrect prior fork implementations would cause consensus failures and potential chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The VM module assumes sufficient gas is available for all operations before execution begins.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Out-of-gas conditions during critical state transitions could leave state partially modified.
